# DIAG-B-01 — what causes the full-rebuild degeneration

> **NOT CLEARED FOR EXTERNAL DISCLOSURE.** Selective recompilation is
> `NOT YET DEMONSTRATED`; every number below is a read-only counterfactual
> on a synthetic fixture, not a demonstrated benefit.

*Generated by `scripts/make_findings.py` from `metrics/summary.json`.*

Read-only counterfactuals over the same 660 document pairs `EXP-0101` used.

## Where the changed set comes from

| source | ids | share |
|---|---|---|
| `evidence_moved_only` | 10,320 | 95.9% |
| `multiple` | 379 | 3.5% |
| `unit_added_only` | 60 | 0.6% |
| **total** | **10,759** | |

**95.9% of the traversal seed set is there because a unit moved and for no other reason.**

## Counterfactuals

| counterfactual | what it changes | rebuild fraction | 95% CI | equivalence | stale |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `actual` | the diff exactly as `akc_cir.semantic_diff` produces it | 1.0000 | [1.0000, 1.0000] | 660/660 | 0 |
| `c2_stable_evidence_ids` | evidence ids held equal where the unit did not move | 0.2503 | [0.2321, 0.2687] | 660/660 | 0 |
| `c3_semantic_channel_only` | only meaning-changing kinds routed into the changed set | 0.1263 | [0.1217, 0.1307] | 660/660 | 0 |
| `c2_and_c3` | both of the above | 0.1263 | [0.1217, 0.1307] | 660/660 | 0 |
| `c4_no_document_rollup` | the document-level rollup artifact removed from the graph | 0.0802 | [0.0762, 0.0842] | 180/660 | 480 |

## Verdict per cause

| cause | verdict | why |
|---|---|---|
| `C1_evidence_identity_design` | **NOT REQUIRED** | C3 alone reaches the floor with equivalence intact, so no change to evidence identity derivation -- and no IDENTITY_SCHEME_VERSION migration -- is implied by this result. |
| `C2_version_scoped_evidence_id` | **CONTRIBUTING, NOT NECESSARY** | Stabilising evidence ids under re-render is safe (equivalence 660/660) and lowers the fraction to 0.2503, but it does not reach C3's 0.1263: a unit that genuinely moved still reports EVIDENCE_MOVED. Adding it to C3 changes nothing. |
| `C3_semantic_evidence_conflation` | **DOMINANT AND SUFFICIENT** | Routing only meaning-changing kinds into the changed set takes 1.0000 to 0.1263 with equivalence 660/660 and zero artifacts left stale. The changed-set channel is where the degeneration lives. |
| `C4_dependency_invalidation_rule` | **REFUTED** | Narrowing the dependency rule is cheaper (0.0802) and wrong: equivalence falls to 180/660 with 480 artifacts left stale. The breadth is real -- the rollup genuinely depends on every unit -- so the rule is doing its job and is not the cause. |

## What this does not establish

- **`0.1263` is a counterfactual, not a demonstrated benefit.** It is what a corrected changed-set channel would have cost on this fixture. No such channel exists, so the claim state stays `NOT YET DEMONSTRATED`.
- **No fix is proposed and none is authorised.** A change to the changed-set channel touches `akc_cir.semantic_diff`, which is Protected Core and goes through the full ladder: compatibility contract, shadow, benchmark, canary, rollout, deprecate.
- **The fixture is synthetic.** Seventeen units per document, every one carrying an evidence id. A corpus whose units mostly lack evidence ids would show a smaller share for `evidence_moved_only`.
